name: Footprint Workers Co-operative
description: Footprint is a workers co-operative based at Cornerstone Resource Centre, Chapeltown in Leeds. Footprint was set up to provide printing services to the highest possible ethical and environmental standards. We have 2 current members who both live in Cornerstone Housing Co-op and have been involved in social and ecological activism for a number of years.
